items.name: viewer-zoom
items.title: Zoom
items.description: Zoom ladder, fit modes, and the page-box maths a viewer resolves them against.

items.name: pdf-page-class
items.title: Page surface class
items.description: The shared Tailwind classes a rendered page is painted with.

items.name: pdf-viewer-store
items.title: Viewer store
items.description: A subscribable store for the open document, page, view mode, rotation, annotation switch and search results, sliced so a page change does not re-render every panel.

items.name: pdf-viewer-provider
items.title: Viewer provider
items.description: Puts a viewer store in scope. Mount it above your router so the document and its render cache survive navigation.

items.name: use-pdf-viewer
items.title: Viewer hooks
items.description: Selector hooks over the viewer store — one subscription per slice, so a component re-renders only for the state it reads.

items.name: use-viewer-zoom
items.title: Zoom controller
items.description: Wheel, pinch and keyboard zoom bound to a scroll container, with the settled scale committed separately from the one the layout follows.

items.name: use-pdf-page-labels
items.title: Page labels
items.description: The labels a document prints on its pages, when they differ from the index.

items.name: pdf-isolation-guard
items.title: Isolation guard
items.description: Refuses to render a viewer on a page that is not cross-origin isolated, and names the two headers that fix it.

items.name: pdf-viewer-layout
items.title: Viewer layout
items.description: The frame a viewer sits in: a resizable, collapsible sidebar that becomes a drawer on a narrow viewer, toolbar with a full-screen toggle, status line and a native scroll area the zoom gestures can bind to.

items.name: pdf-viewer
items.title: PDF viewer
items.description: A complete viewer: sidebar, toolbar with find, view rotation and a continuous scrolling column. Give it an open document and it works.

items.name: pdf-viewer-basic
items.title: Basic PDF viewer
items.description: One page at a time with a pager and zoom. The viewer to embed in a panel or a modal, where the full one would be more furniture than document.

items.name: pdf-page-preview
items.title: Page preview
items.description: One page, rendered once, with nothing to interact with — for the places a PDF is a picture rather than a document.

items.name: pdf-thumbnail-picker
items.title: Thumbnail picker
items.description: Pick a page out of a document: a streaming grid of thumbnails, controlled or not.

items.name: pdf-preview-dialog
items.title: Preview dialog
items.description: A document in a dialog, for previewing an attachment without leaving the page.

items.name: pdf-page-canvas
items.title: Page canvas
items.description: A declarative canvas for small bitmaps, such as thumbnails.

items.name: pdf-page-view
items.title: Page view
items.description: The main viewport canvas, painted imperatively so a multi-megabyte page never passes through React state.

items.name: pdf-page-image-view
items.title: Page image view
items.description: The encoded-image path: an fed from an encoded page, with a correctly sized placeholder until it decodes.

items.name: pdf-links
items.title: Link layer
items.description: Hit regions over a page for its link annotations, invisible until hovered, mapped through a viewport so they follow a rotated view.

items.name: pdf-highlights
items.title: Search highlights
items.description: An SVG overlay drawing search hits as quadrilaterals at the text's own angle.

items.name: pdf-page-surface
items.title: Page surface
items.description: One page in a scrolling column: its canvas, its link layer and its highlights, rendered at a priority the caller sets.

items.name: pdf-continuous-pages
items.title: Continuous pages
items.description: A windowed scrolling column of pages, sized from pageSize() so the column can be scrolled to the end before anything has rendered, and re-flowed for a rotated view without re-rendering one.

items.name: pdf-thumbnails
items.title: Thumbnails
items.description: A streaming thumbnail strip, sized by output width rather than DPI so a large-format drawing cannot exhaust the tab.

items.name: pdf-outline
items.title: Outline
items.description: The document outline as a collapsible tree, opening each node as the document asks.

items.name: pdf-structure
items.title: Structure
items.description: The tag tree of a tagged PDF, and the reading order it declares — with the count of how many lines that moves.

items.name: pdf-find-bar
items.title: Find bar
items.description: Find in document, from the toolbar: a popover with the query, previous/next, match case and whole words. Runs the search outward from the page on screen so the first result is usually the one wanted.

items.name: pdf-search
items.title: Search results
items.description: The results of the find bar's search as a list of hits with context, for a sidebar panel.

items.name: pdf-sidebar
items.title: Viewer sidebar
items.description: Pages, outline, tags, attachments and search results in one column, picked from a menu rather than a tab strip, every panel kept mounted so a switch does not discard a thumbnail stream or a result set.

items.name: viewer-zoom-bar
items.title: Zoom bar
items.description: Pager, zoom steppers and fit-mode select for a viewer toolbar, with rotation, the annotation switch, the view mode and document properties behind a more menu.

items.name: pdf-attachments
items.title: Attachments
items.description: The files a document embeds, with an inline preview for text and a save button — and a hybrid invoice called out by name.

items.name: pdf-properties
items.title: Document properties
items.description: The metadata dialog every viewer has: file, title, dates, producer, page size and a content fingerprint.

items.name: pdf-password-prompt
items.title: Password prompt
items.description: One form that either asks for a password cold or says the last answer was wrong.

items.name: file-preview-core
items.title: File preview core
items.description: Renderer descriptors, detection by bytes before names, the types that make an allow list name only installed formats, and sources: files, URLs and signed-URL resolvers, fetched once into a shared cache.

items.name: file-preview
items.title: File preview
items.description: Previews a list of mixed files one at a time, with a typed allow list. Formats are separate items: install only the ones you show.

items.name: file-preview-image
items.title: Image renderer
items.description: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, BMP, ICO and SVG for the file preview, drawn by the browser and zoomed like a page. No engine.

items.name: file-preview-code
items.title: Code renderer
items.description: Source and plain text for the file preview, highlighted by shiki. Grammars load one at a time, as files need them.

items.name: file-preview-pdf
items.title: PDF renderer
items.description: PDF for the file preview, through papyra: opens the file, asks for a password, and shows the one-page viewer.

items.name: use-file-preview-media
items.title: Media source
items.description: A media element's src, refreshed once when playback fails, so a signed link that expires mid-video resumes where it was.

items.name: file-preview-video
items.title: Video renderer
items.description: MP4, MOV, WebM and Ogg video for the file preview, played by the browser and streamed rather than downloaded. No dependencies.

items.name: file-preview-audio
items.title: Audio renderer
items.description: MP3, AAC, M4A, WAV, FLAC and Ogg audio for the file preview, played by the browser and streamed rather than downloaded.
